'''Tenzan Shrine''' (天山社 or 天山神社) refers to a group of {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines|1=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Saga Prefecture|en|Saga Prefecture|qid=Q160420|lt=Saga Prefecture|1=Saga Prefecture}} on {{ill|Tianshan (disambiguation)|en|Tianshan (disambiguation)|qid=Q1305751|lt=Tenzan (Saga Prefecture)|1=Tianshan (disambiguation)}}. These shrines are traditionally regarded as the third shrine (三宮) of {{ill|Hizen Province|en|Hizen Province|qid=Q906926|lt=Hizen Province|1=Hizen Province}}. There are four registered religious corporations under this name.

* {{ill|Tenzan Shrine (Ogimachi Hatada)|ja|天山神社 (小城市小城町畑田)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenzan Shrine (Ogimachi Hatada)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Upper Shrine (上宮) located at the summit of Tenzan. Situated in Hatada, Ogimachi, Saga Prefecture.
* {{ill|Tenzan Shrine (Main Shrine)|ja|天山社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenzan Shrine (Main Shrine)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Known as the Lower Shrine (下宮) or Main Shrine (本宮). Located in Haruki, Ogimachi, Saga Prefecture.
* {{ill|Tenzan Shrine (Ogimachi Iwakura)|ja|天山神社 (小城市小城町岩蔵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenzan Shrine (Ogimachi Iwakura)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Lower Shrine (下宮). Situated in Iwakura, Ogimachi, Saga Prefecture.
* {{ill|Tenzan Shrine (Karatsu City)|ja|天山神社 (唐津市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenzan Shrine (Karatsu City)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Lower Shrine (下宮). Located in Hirose, Kyūragi Town, Karatsu City, Saga Prefecture.
